title: Adam Kadmon
html_source:
Adam Kadmon is the Qabalistic name for Adam, the first man on earth, according the Christian theology, and is the sort of “primordial soup” of souls that are molded according to YHWH’s will. This finds its parallel within Ulysses, with all the talk of the transmigration of souls in the fourth chapter, (the “metempsychosis” conversation).

The concept of Adam Kadmon is used in another impenetrable work, the anime Neon Genesis Evangelion, and even though it is called “Human Instrumentality” in that show, it’s similarly a massive pool of souls waiting to be shaped.

This concept connects with the “Proteus” theme of the chapter: Proteus was a shapeshifting god with no real form.
